hooks.command: if [ -n "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" ] && [ "$(uname -s)" = "Linux" ]; then mkdir -p "$HOME/.rea-engines"; (setsid nohup bash "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/install-engines.sh" --background >> "$HOME/.rea-engines/install.log" 2>&1 &); echo 'REA: engine install started in background (log: ~/.rea-engines/install.log)'; fi
